label: Search
notes: spec 2026-10-16 battle-system §13.2: sweep the circle for the enemy; default keep distance and report, or approach into a stand-off; needs no named target

label: Raid
notes: §13.3: plunder known reachable stores inside the circle; the target KIND is an optional filter so no target is required; a defended target is scouted and engaged, never plundered from afar

label: Destroy
notes: §13.4: the player names the object kind (camp and engines, military granaries, transport works, manor workshops); only found legal objects are acted on

label: Siege
notes: §13.5: one known town inside the circle, named explicitly; march, camp and blockade then follow the §14 tactic
